method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (wirc-core.l4: dates with built-in date functions only, the varied amounts for 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2027 copied by hand from the deposited Gazette notice with their lines, and the rules) and one seat layer that restates no rule (wirc-seat.l4, 29 questions with @export and @desc); five regulative rules (s 18; s 75(1) with s 178(3); s 165(3); s 330; s 335(2)(d) with s 337(1)), tested by EVALTRACE, never taken as inputs; no REFUSE (a case outside the encoding answers NOTHING, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Workplace Injury Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 2013 (Vic), Act No. 67/2013, Version No. 054 as at 2 October 2026 (including No. 8/2024, the WorkCover Scheme Modernisation amendments, ss 4-26 in force 31 March 2024), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/workplace-injury-rehabilitation-and-compensation-act-2013.txt (sha256 b7b33dfc074ef55499d66fa194717105cbbfce50112275384a97c649366611ad), converted from the Word file the owner saved by hand on 2026-11-06; varied amounts from Victoria Government Gazette No. S 363 of 30 June 2026 (subjects/au/vic/workers-compensation-annual-indexation-notice/registers/source-bundle/GG2026S363.txt, sha256 04c8fe556bca3ef38185cf933965d9a6526da59cac06fb470eec02fe5945499a, lines 389-733), the 'Rate before 1 July 2026' column read as 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 and the 'Rate from 1 July 2026' column as 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027

seat: the injured worker (a worker injured in employment connected with Victoria), and, for the death benefit questions, the worker's dependent partners, dependent children and close family members

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run wirc-core.l4 ; l4 run wirc-seat.l4 ; l4 run wirc-cases.l4
checks.result: 192 written, 192 satisfied in wirc-cases.l4; 0 errors, 0 warnings in all three files (2026-11-06)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read; a copy of the case file with one expected value changed was run first to confirm failures are reported, and not kept.

scope: In: s 37(1), s 39(1), (1A), (2A), s 40(1), (1A), (2), (2A), (3)-(7), s 625(1) (entitlement, mental injury and the 2024 amendments); s 18(1), (3)-(7), s 20(8), s 75(1), s 178(3) (notice, claim, decision); ss 263AA, 263B, 263I (provisional payments for a mental injury); s 152, s 159, ss 161, 162, 163(1), (2), 165(3)-(5), s 625(2), ss 169, 171, s 189(1), (3) (weekly payments and the second-entitlement test); s 197(2), (3), s 210(1), s 211(2), s 212, ss 217, 219 (impairment benefit); s 236(1)-(5), s 237A (death); s 325(2)(e)-(g), s 328(2)(b), s 329A, s 330(1), (3), s 335(1), (2)(d)(i), s 337(1), s 340 (common law and the serious injury gateway). Inputs: employment connected with Victoria, mental injury, current work capacity, pre-injury average weekly earnings, deductible amount, current weekly earnings, whole person impairment, impairment benefit rating and its description, retirement age, dependants, the Authority's determinations and waivers. Out: Parts 1, 4, 6, 8-12, most of 13, the Schedules; ss 41-51 except as facts; ss 153-158; ss 164, 164A, 167-168, 170, 172-177, 180-188, 190-194; ss 196, 198-209, 213-216, 218, 221 and Schedule 4; Division 7 of Part 5; ss 237, 237AA, 240-243; Division 9 of Part 5; s 75A business-day deadlines; Part 7 Division 1, ss 326, 329, 331-334, 336, 338-339, 341-349, Divisions 3-6. See NOTES.md.
